faq_heading: Surrey houses under $1.2 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Surrey houses sell for under $1,200,000?
faq.a: 361 of 946, or 38%. 245 of them sold between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999.

faq.q: How much more does $1,200,000 buy than $1,000,000 in Surrey?
faq.a: 245 more sales, 26% of the market. The share under the cap rises from 12% to 38%.

faq.q: Which Surrey areas have house medians near $1,200,000?
faq.a: Bear Creek Green Timbers ($1,272,000, 73 sales) to Fraser Heights ($1,559,000, 82 sales) are the ten closest, for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is $1,200,000 enough for a house in Surrey?
faq.a: The median was $1,300,000, so $1,200,000 is 8% below it, and 38% of 946 sales closed under it.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,200,000).

In Surrey, 361 of the 946 houses (38%) sold under $1,200,000: 116 for less than $1,000,000 and 245 more between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 328 sales.

The lower quarter of Surrey houses sold at $1,100,000 or less, $100,000 under $1,200,000, and the upper quarter at $1,534,250 or more, $334,250 above it. A house at the cap would sit below the median.
